corrected_content.problem: Given that $\mathbf{F}(x,y)=xy\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{i}+y\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{j}$, what is the scalar curl of $\mathbf{F}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: For $\mathbf F=\langle P,Q\rangle=\langle xy,y\rangle$, the scalar curl is $Q_x-P_y=0-x=-x$.
